I can already see the issue! Both gateway pods mount the `gateway-limits` ConfigMap using a `subPath` volume mount:

```
"mountPath": "/etc/gateway/limits.yaml", "subPath": "limits.yaml"
```

According to the Kubernetes documentation (chunk_id: `tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-pod-configmap#mounted-configmaps-are-updated-automatically-0` and `concepts/configuration/configmap#using-configmaps-as-files-from-a-pod-4`):

> "A container using a ConfigMap as a subPath volume will not receive ConfigMap updates."
This confirms the root cause: any ConfigMap update won't reach the pods since they're using subPath, meaning the pods need a restart to pick up the new config. I should also check the pod logs for further confirmation.
